source: src/core/battle/transform.ts header (GAME_DESIGN.md 5f) and THE OVERHAUL.md section 3.5; checked against the engine by tests/unit/transformCheck.test.ts

mega.name: Mega Evolution / Primal Reversion
mega.unlockedBy: the form's Mega Stone (or Red/Blue Orb for Primal) in the Bag
mega.persistsThroughRun: Mega Ring and stones stay in the Bag
mega.perPokemon: every Pokémon with its stone transforms by itself

tera.name: Terastallization
tera.persistsThroughRun: Tera Orb stays in the Bag
tera.perPokemon: a Pokémon uses at most one of Tera, Z-Move and Dynamax per battle

zmove.name: Z-Move
zmove.unlockedBy: Z-Ring plus the Z-Crystal of the move's type
zmove.reverts: the Z-Move is a single move; nothing to revert
zmove.persistsThroughRun: Z-Ring and crystals stay in the Bag
zmove.perPokemon: a Pokémon uses at most one of Tera, Z-Move and Dynamax per battle

dynamax.name: Dynamax / Gigantamax
dynamax.unlockedBy: Dynamax Band (Gigantamax form if the species has one)
dynamax.limit: once per battle per side, for balance.transformations.dynamaxTurns turns
dynamax.reverts: after its turns, on switching out or fainting, and at end of battle
dynamax.persistsThroughRun: Dynamax Band stays in the Bag
dynamax.perPokemon: a Pokémon uses at most one of Tera, Z-Move and Dynamax per battle
